summary: Implemented the feature without running tests or repository code, as instructed. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save, save_batch, finalize; ordered cache; overwrite=False merge where file rows replace in-memory values and file-only keys are appended) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver with private static _create_file_basename, per-item immediate writes, dtype None keeps data dtype). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, leaving the GIF helpers unchanged. Reduced monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py, classification_saver.py, and tensorboard_handlers.py to thin adapters; classification registers an engine-accepting wrapper around finalize; TensorBoard handler gained index before max_channels. Changed write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename, and added test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Verified by reading only: no circular imports, no leftover old names, single trailing newline on edited files, lines within 120 characters. Not verified: flake8 run, test execution, and ignite 0.3.0 attach behaviour. Nothing committed. Extra choices: NIfTI saver converts tensor affines to numpy; per-item meta data includes all mapping keys.
